body:
the floral piano is real, and taylor just sat down at it and played three songs like it was nothing. 🎹

for the Recording Academy's 20-year Songwriters & Composers Wing retrospective at the Grammy Museum, she ran a live medley: "I Knew It, I Knew You" (her new Toy Story 5 song) straight into "august," straight into "All Too Well" — one of this year's songs bridging into a folklore summer memory and one of her oldest, rawest breakups.

it's up on her own YouTube channel now, and we've added the video to the Videos rail under folklore on the site (that's where "august" lives).

no confirmation this is literally the Eras Tour piano — just a piano someone painted head to toe in flowers, which honestly might be even better.

longlivets.com/?era=folklore&utm_source=instagram&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=track-fact
why: Founder-directed reactive post (Joey, 2026-08-25) — the missing Instagram companion to social/posted/2026-08-25-icon-sessions-grammy-museum-x.json, whose own `why` field admitted 'no Instagram sibling drafted this round.' Instagram posting auto-cross-posts to Facebook (postToFacebookPage), which is the other channel that was missed on the original run. Same facts as the X post, same campaign (shared story per docs/marketing/social-strategy.md §1's story-unique rule) so this and the X item read as one story across metrics: new Vault video (supabase/seed/videos/folklore.mjs#icon-sessions-grammy-museum-medley, PR #3278, merged 2026-08-25T13:37:47Z) of Taylor's own official YouTube channel's live medley of "I Knew It, I Knew You" (Toy Story 5 single, no album era), "august" (folklore), and "All Too Well" (Red) for The Recording Academy Songwriters & Composers Wing 20-Year Retrospective at the Grammy Museum. Filed under folklore per the posted X item's precedent (2021 Grammys-medley filing, since 'august' is folklore's own song); song titles/venue verified against PR #3278's merged diff. Link /?era=folklore for the same reason as the X sibling: videos have no dedicated /?item= deep link, so this points to the era page where the video surfaces in the Videos rail. Media reused from the X post: Joey's own screenshot of the performance (mediaKind deliberately "site-screen", not "photo" — it's a video screengrab, not a credited vault photo; not previously used in any of the last 10 posted Instagram items, so the IG media-reuse guard is clear). Caption is IG-format (multi-paragraph, more visual-first per social-strategy.md's IG conventions in social/posted/2026-08-19-mood-chat-howto-ig.json and social/posted/2026-08-24-runway-sister-eras-challenge-ig.json) but carries no fact beyond what the X post/PR #3278 support — same absolute-sourcing caveat as the X post: dropped any claim that the piano is literally the Eras Tour piano, since nothing confirms that beyond what's visually apparent (painted with flowers). Opener deliberately different from the X sibling's "OMG the PIANO!!" (first-6-words formula-opener check reads the last 14 days of posted/queue, which includes today's X post) — this one opens "the floral piano is real, and taylor just sat...". Register per docs/marketing/social-strategy.md's 2026-08-25 update: fan-gush, feeling first, one real detail. scheduledAt set for the next couple of poster runs (30-min cadence) after this PR merges — reactive/prompt, not a calendar slot.
